prompt: It would be necessary to convert the mass of ________ x109 protons into energy in order to release 27.2 J of energy.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly applies E=mc^2, computes the proton mass and converts it to a total proton count of ~1.81×10^11, then correctly expresses this as x×10^9 protons to get x=181. Candidate 4 also gets the correct proton count (~1.81×10^11) but does not provide the requested x value for the blank.
